projects.name: CI/CD Pipeline for Jenkins, Ansible & Docker
projects.description: Built an end-to-end CI/CD pipeline on a self-managed Ubuntu VM: Jenkins builds a Docker image and pushes it to Docker Hub on every commit. Configured Ansible for automated deployment and SSH-key-based authentication between the Jenkins controller and target hosts.

projects.name: Scalable AWS Infrastructure
projects.description: A console-guided reference build of a scalable VPC, EC2 fleet, Application Load Balancer, and CloudWatch monitoring setup, documented as a step-by-step portfolio guide.

projects.name: Dockerized-React-Application
projects.description: Containerized a React.js app with Docker and used Docker Compose to orchestrate it alongside an Nginx reverse proxy, simplifying multi-container deployment.
